title: 四级长对话：租车路线与暗房课程
instruction: 听完整一节两段长对话及各段后读出的问题，依次选择最佳答案。音频中材料和问题各读一遍，卷面只印四个选项。本原创使用节内编号1—8，各段对应1—4、5—8题。播放器可回听，正式单次听辨条件未强制。
audio_introduction: Section B. You will hear two long conversations. After each, you will hear questions. Each recording and each question will be spoken only once. Choose the best answer from A, B, C and D.
source_form_notice: 四级形式参照2024年12月第一套转载Section B：2段、4/4共8回应、每题四选；原创采用节内编号，问题只在录音与作者区。全部自有虚构内容及本机合成试听，非原考试原声；未独立教研/听辨/学生难度或产品等值验证。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I would like to hire two bicycles for Sunday. Your website says the riverside branch opens at nine, but our train arrives at eight thirty.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That branch still opens at nine. The station branch opens at eight, though, so you could collect the bicycles there and ride down to the river.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Would that cost more? We had planned to return them beside the river, not at the station.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The daily hire price is the same at both branches. Returning to a different branch adds five pounds for each bicycle. If you bring them back here, there is no extra charge.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I see. My brother is arriving separately and will not reach the river until ten. Could he collect his bicycle there while I collect mine at the station?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Certainly, but each person must show identification when collecting. You cannot collect for him unless he comes with you.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That is fine. We are both adults. Do we need to bring helmets?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No, helmets and locks are included. Bring a small bag for your own things, because these bicycles do not have baskets.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: What happens if the weather is terrible? I do not want to pay for a whole day and then be unable to ride.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You can cancel without charge until six on Saturday evening. After that, the booking payment is not refunded. We do not close simply because it rains.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Then I will make two separate bookings and check the forecast on Saturday. I can return my bicycle at the station before our train home.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Good. Put the collection and return branches on each form. That avoids any confusion when you arrive.

questions.spoken_question: Why does the man mention the station branch?
options: It opens before the riverside branch.
It is the only branch with two bicycles.
It provides a free train ticket.
questions.rationale: A八点比河边九点早，适合八点半到；B未缺车，C同日价，D无赠票。

questions.spoken_question: What adds to the normal hire charge?
options: Returning a bicycle to another branch.
Collecting after ten in the morning.
questions.rationale: B异店还每车加五镑；A头盔含，C自带包非收费，D时间无此费。

questions.spoken_question: Why can the woman not collect her brother’s bicycle alone?
options: Her brother must choose a basket first.
Only children may collect two bicycles.
The riverside branch will be closed all day.
Each collector must show identification in person.
questions.rationale: D各人领须出示身份，她不能独代；A无车篮，B二人成人，C河边九点开。

questions.spoken_question: What does the woman plan to do on Saturday?
options: Ask the branches to change their opening times.
Return both bicycles to the river.
questions.rationale: C周六看预报且六点免费取消界限；A无改营业，B已过界，D返车在使用后不是取消前。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I saw your advertisement for a photography course. I use a phone most of the time, but I would like to try making prints in a darkroom.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: We have a Saturday digital editing class and a Wednesday darkroom course. For the Wednesday course, you work with black-and-white film. You do not need your own film camera; we can lend you one.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That sounds right. Do beginners start immediately with the darkroom chemicals?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: No. The first meeting covers using the camera and loading film. At the second, you develop the film with the tutor. Printing begins in the third week. You must attend the safety introduction before using the darkroom.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I can come every Wednesday except the first one. Could I read the instructions at home and join the second meeting?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The introduction includes a demonstration and a check with the tutor, so reading it is not enough. But we repeat it on the Friday after the first meeting. You could attend that instead.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Friday is possible. I finish work at five. What time does that extra meeting begin?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: At six thirty, and it lasts one hour. It is included in the course fee. Materials for your first roll of film are included too, but additional film must be bought separately.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: One roll will be enough to start with. Can I keep the borrowed camera between lessons?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes, after completing a loan form. It must be returned at the final meeting. The prints you make are yours to keep.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Good. Please book the course and the Friday introduction for me. I will borrow a camera rather than buy one before I know whether I enjoy working with film.

questions.spoken_question: What is the man especially interested in learning?
options: Editing colour pictures on a phone.
Making photographic prints in a darkroom.
questions.rationale: C开头想darkroomprints，非A数字编辑/B修机/D经营。

questions.spoken_question: What happens at the first regular meeting?
options: Students learn camera use and film loading.
Students make their final exhibition prints.
Students buy additional rolls of film.
questions.rationale: A第一会camera/loading；B打印第三周才起，C额外胶卷非第一会内容，D末次还。

questions.spoken_question: Why can the man not simply read the introduction at home?
options: It is written in a language he cannot read.
It requires a tutor demonstration and check.
It is available only to experienced photographers.
It begins after all the printing lessons.
questions.rationale: B展示及导师核查必须到场，A未语言困难，C初学可，D先于暗房。

questions.spoken_question: What will the man do on Friday?
options: Collect his final prints from the shop.
Teach another beginner to load a camera.
Return the camera before the course starts.
questions.rationale: D重复入门周五六点半，A未开印/B非任教/C借至末次。
